scholarshipName: PEC-PG — Programa de Estudantes-Convênio de Pós-Graduação (Mestrado pleno)
provider: CAPES / CNPq, with Ministério das Relações Exteriores (Divisão de Temas Educacionais)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE — YES. PEC-PG is open to nationals of just over 70 participating countries in Africa, Latin America/Caribbean, Asia and Europe. The Africa list (29 countries) is reported as: África do Sul, Angola, Argélia, Benin, Botsuana, Burkina Faso, Cabo Verde, Camarões, Costa do Marfim, Egito, Etiópia, Gabão, Gana, Guiné Bissau, Guiné Equatorial, Mali, Marrocos, Moçambique, Namíbia, Nigéria, Quênia, República Democrática do Congo, República do Congo, São Tomé e Príncipe, Senegal, Tanzânia, Togo, TUNÍSIA e Zâmbia. Core rule quoted from coverage of the edital: 'Podem participar cidadãos estrangeiros nacionais de países participantes do programa e que neles residam, não tenham nacionalidade brasileira, dupla nacionalidade brasileira ou direito à nacionalidade brasileira no momento da inscrição.' The candidate must therefore be a Tunisian national RESIDENT IN TUNISIA at the time of application (he is), and must not hold or be entitled to Brazilian nationality.
ageLimit: No age limit stated in the sources reached. UNVERIFIED.
subjectScope: All subject areas — any programme in the CAPES-evaluated stricto sensu postgraduate system, including music/arts programmes (Brazil has strong PPGs in Música with computer-music/sonology lines, e.g. UNICAMP, UFRGS, UFMG, UNESP).
coverage: Monthly stipend (bolsa), health-insurance allowance, and international airfare funded by the Brazilian MRE. Brazilian federal/state public universities charge ZERO tuition to foreigners, so the scholarship is on top of already-free tuition. Exact 2027 monthly value UNVERIFIED (mestrado bolsa is normally the standard CAPES domestic rate).
deadline: For the 2026 intake cycle: applications 14 August – 29 September 2025 (one source cites an extension to 8 October 2025); final results 17 December 2025; studies begin first semester 2026. The equivalent 2027-intake call should therefore open around August 2026 and close around late September / early October 2026 — i.e. roughly NOW for a September 2027 start, though note Brazilian academic year starts in MARCH, so a 'September 2027' target maps to the March 2027 or March 2028 Brazilian intake. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
howToApply: Online only at https://inscricao.capes.gov.br/ . Contact inscricao.pecpg@capes.gov.br . No embassy step for the CAPES modality (the CNPq doctorate modality historically routed via embassies).
requiresAdmissionFirst: YES — the candidate must first secure a carta de aceite / admission from a CAPES-recommended Brazilian postgraduate programme before submitting the PEC-PG application. This means contacting a Brazilian PPG em Música supervisor roughly 6-9 months before the call.
notes: The CAPES landing page reached directly confirms the programme, its benefits ('Mensalidade, Auxílio seguro saúde, Passagem Brasil – exterior (financiada pelo MRE)'), the timetable and the application portal, but does NOT itself enumerate the countries. The Tunisia listing is confirmed by multiple independent Brazilian institutional restatements of Edital 12/2025 (Andifes, UFG/PRPG, IHT-UFF, CRUB, Abruc, CNN Brasil), all of which give the identical 29-country Africa list including Tunísia. The gov.br/mec news page and the edital PDF itself were behind a CAPTCHA and could not be fetched — treat the country list as HIGH CONFIDENCE BUT NOT PRIMARY-SOURCED. 650 places in the 2026 cycle: 100 doutorado pleno, 350 doutorado-sanduíche, 200 MESTRADO PLENO (24 months max).
verificationStatus: Tunisia eligibility: confirmed via multiple secondary restatements of the official edital; primary edital PDF UNVERIFIED (CAPTCHA-blocked).

scholarshipName: Beca de Excelencia del Gobierno de México para Extranjeros (AMEXCID)
provider: Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE) / Agencia Mexicana de Cooperación Internacional para el Desarrollo (AMEXCID)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE — YES. The official 'ANEXO 5 — PAISES ELEGIBLES' annex to the convocatoria lists, under the heading 'AFRICA', item 4: 'LA REPÚBLICA DE TÚNEZ' (2023 annex) and item 5: 'LA REPÚBLICA DE TÚNEZ' (2024 annex). Both annexes were downloaded and read directly. The convocatoria is described as offered to 'más de 170 países, en el marco de convenios bilaterales, de mecanismos multilaterales y de acuerdos especiales'.
ageLimit: Not stated in the annexes retrieved. Historically no hard age cap for the maestría modality but UNVERIFIED for 2026/2027.
subjectScope: All fields, restricted to programmes at the ~90 eligible Mexican HEIs listed in Anexo 1, all registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP). Mexican SNP includes music/arts posgrados (e.g. UNAM, UdeG, UAM), but whether an electronic-music/music-technology maestría sits on the Anexo 1 list is UNVERIFIED.
coverage: Tuition and registration fees; monthly living stipend (reported at roughly EUR 670/month for maestría, EUR 840 for doctorado); IMSS medical insurance; Mexican visa fee exemption; round-trip international airfare for eligible countries; domestic transport where needed. Stipend figures are from a secondary source — UNVERIFIED against the official convocatoria.
deadline: 2026 cycle: applications closed 22 June 2026, results 6–10 July 2026. The 2027 call should be expected in roughly the same window (the convocatoria has moved around: earlier editions ran July–September). 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
applicationOpens: Varies by edition; the 2026 edition was open in the first half of 2026 (closing 22 June 2026). Earlier editions opened July–September.
howToApply: Online through the SIGCA platform (https://sigca.sre.gob.mx), with documentation submitted through the Mexican Embassy or Consulate accredited to the applicant's country. NOTE: Mexico does not have a resident embassy in Tunis; the concurrent mission would need to be identified — UNVERIFIED which mission handles Tunisia.
requiresAdmissionFirst: YES — a university acceptance letter (carta de aceptación) from an eligible Mexican HEI is one of the required documents. Minimum GPA equivalent to 8.0/10. Spanish proficiency required for Spanish-taught programmes.
notes: Two official annex PDFs were retrieved and read: file/825056 (2023 edition) and file/916003 (2024 edition). Both list LA REPÚBLICA DE TÚNEZ under AFRICA. The 2026-edition annex could not be downloaded — the gob.mx HTML document-listing pages (https://www.gob.mx/amexcid/documentos/becas-de-excelencia-del-gobierno-de-mexico-para-extranjeros-2026) are behind an Akamai bot challenge and returned a 'Challenge Validation' page, and probing for a 2026 Anexo 5 file ID failed. Tunisia's presence in the 2026 annex is therefore INFERRED from two consecutive prior editions, not directly verified. The Anexo 1 (Instituciones Elegibles) 2026 PDF IS reachable at https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/1082428/ANEXO_1_INSTITUCIONES_ELEGIBLES_2026.pdf — check there for any music/arts posgrado. Modalities include full maestría up to 24 months.
verificationStatus: Tunisia eligibility: DIRECTLY VERIFIED in the 2023 and 2024 official annexes; 2026/2027 annex UNVERIFIED.

scholarshipName: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) — Bilateral Program (Type A), Chinese Embassy in Tunisia channel
provider: China Scholarship Council (CSC) / Ministry of Education of the PRC, administered for Tunisians by the Embassy of the PRC in Tunis and the Tunisian Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur (Direction générale de la coopération internationale)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE AND HAS A BILATERAL EMBASSY CHANNEL — YES. The Embassy of the PRC in Tunisia publishes a dedicated annual notice: 'Avis sur la demande de bourse du gouvernement chinois pour l'année universitaire 2026-2027', which states 'Il est désormais accessible de soumettre une candidature en ligne pour la bourse du gouvernement chinois pour l'année scolaire 2026/2027 jusqu'au 18 février 2026' with the portal 'https://www.campuschina.org/fr/'. The existence of this embassy notice is the operative proof of a bilateral (Type A) quota for Tunisia. Separately, in February 2026 the Tunisian Ministry of Higher Education announced 20 Chinese Government scholarships for the 2026/2027 year for licence, master's and doctoral students of OIC member states including Tunisia.
ageLimit: Age limits are set per study cycle by CSC (typically under 35 for master's applicants). The Tunisian ministry notice refers to 'compliance with age requirements set for each study cycle'. Exact figure for master's UNVERIFIED from a primary CSC page.
subjectScope: All disciplines offered by CSC-designated Chinese universities. Electronic music / music technology exists in China (e.g. Central Conservatory of Music Beijing, Shanghai Conservatory electronic music departments) and these are CSC-designated institutions — but whether a specific programme is available under the Tunisia bilateral quota is UNVERIFIED.
coverage: Tuition fees, accommodation, monthly living allowance, and comprehensive medical insurance for the full duration of study in China ('Frais de scolarité, logement, allocation mensuelle et assurance santé pris en charge').
deadline: 2026/2027 cycle: online CSC application via campuschina.org open until 18 FEBRUARY 2026 (Chinese Embassy in Tunis notice). Separately, for the 20 OIC-linked places the Tunisian ministry dossier deadline was 28 FEBRUARY 2026, with a compulsory CSCA (Chinese Academic Competence Test) sitting on 25 MARCH 2026 registered at https://csca.cn/home . The equivalent 2027/2028 deadlines should fall in the SAME WINDOW — roughly November 2026 (opening) to mid/late February 2027 — for a SEPTEMBER 2027 start. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED but the pattern is stable.
applicationOpens: The embassy notice for the 2026/2027 round was published 15 November 2025, so expect the 2027/2028 notice around November 2026.
howToApply: EMBASSY CHANNEL (Type A / Bilateral Program): apply online at https://www.campuschina.org/fr/ entering the agency number of the Chinese Embassy in Tunisia, and submit the paper dossier to the Embassy (22 Rue Dr. Burnet, Tunis 1002; tel 71780064; chinaemb_tn@mfa.gov.cn) and/or via the Tunisian university → Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur, Direction générale de la coopération internationale. The specific AGENCY NUMBER for the Chinese Embassy in Tunis was NOT found — UNVERIFIED; the applicant must obtain it from the embassy notice attachments. UNIVERSITY CHANNEL (Type B) also exists in parallel: apply directly to a CSC-designated Chinese university with the university's own agency number; this does not require a national quota and is generally the more accessible route for a candidate with no ministry backing.
requiresAdmissionFirst: For the embassy/bilateral route, a pre-admission letter is strongly advised and the Tunisian ministry notice explicitly requires 'prior admission to one of the Chinese scholarship programs'. For the university route, admission and scholarship are decided together by the university.
notes: The embassy also warns: it has established no paid consulting service for study/scholarship applications and has authorised no third-party agency — Tunisian students should not use paid agents. Corroborating Tunisian coverage of the 20 OIC places: https://www.leconomistemaghrebin.com/2026/02/24/chine-20-bourses-pour-etudiants-tunisiens-oci-en-2026-2027/ . Note that the 20 OIC-linked places are a DIFFERENT, narrower scheme from the general bilateral CGS quota. Tunisia–China talks in August 2026 reportedly discussed increasing/doubling the number of scholarships for Tunisian students. Language: Chinese or English proficiency required; the CSCA test was made compulsory for the OIC scheme in 2026.
verificationStatus: Tunisia has an embassy channel: DIRECTLY VERIFIED from the Chinese Embassy in Tunis. Agency number and exact quota size for the general bilateral programme: UNVERIFIED.

scholarshipName: PAEC OEA-GCUB — Programa de Alianzas para la Educación y la Capacitación (Becas Brasil)
provider: Organization of American States (OAS/OEA) + Grupo Coimbra / GCUB (Grupo de Cooperação Internacional de Universidades Brasileiras)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS NOT ELIGIBLE — NO. PAEC is restricted to citizens and/or permanent residents of OAS Member States (34 countries of the Americas), excluding Brazil. Tunisia is not an OAS member state, and no African country is. Quoted eligibility as published: 'You must be a citizen and/or permanent resident of any OAS Member State, except for Brazil.' RULE THIS SCHEME OUT.
subjectScope: Master's and doctoral (stricto sensu) programmes at participating Brazilian universities; ~258 places in the tenth edition.
coverage: Tuition waiver at the Brazilian host university plus, in some cases, a maintenance stipend; the candidate normally covers airfare and visa costs.
requiresAdmissionFirst: No — applicants select programmes from the GCUB catalogue within the call.
notes: NEGATIVE FINDING, recorded deliberately. The GCUB website itself (gcub.org.br) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching, so the eligibility clause is taken from the OAS scholarships page and from institutional restatements (UFJF international office, UFC). The 'OAS Member States only' rule is structural to the programme (it is an OAS partnership), not a year-specific restriction, so this is a firm no. THE USEFUL ALTERNATIVE IS GCUB-Mob — see the separate record.
verificationStatus: Tunisia ineligible: high confidence (structural OAS membership rule); gcub.org.br primary page UNVERIFIED (403).

scholarshipName: GCUB-Mob — Programa GCUB de Mobilidade Internacional (Bolsas de Mestrado)
provider: Grupo de Cooperação Internacional de Universidades Brasileiras (GCUB), with support of the Brazilian Ministério das Relações Exteriores and CAPES
whoCanApply: TUNISIA APPEARS ELIGIBLE — YES (open-list scheme, not a closed country list). The edital's general requirements, read verbatim from the official PDF of Edital GCUB-Mob Nº 001/2025, are: '3.1. Requisitos gerais para inscrições: a. Apresentar candidatura em português, inglês, espanhol ou francês. b. SER CIDADÃO(Ã) DE ESTADO QUE MANTENHA RELAÇÃO DIPLOMÁTICA COM O BRASIL. c. Não possuir nacionalidade brasileira. d. Declarar que está em boas condições de saúde (física e mental) para realizar estudos de pós-graduação. e. Ter capacidade para financiar despesas extras não cobertas pela bolsa, por exemplo: passagem aérea, processamento [de visto]...'. There is NO closed annex of countries: the programme is described as 'destinadas a estudantes internacionais provenientes dos CINCO CONTINENTES'. Tunisia maintains full diplomatic relations with Brazil, so a Tunisian national qualifies. IMPORTANT PRACTICAL POINT: applications may be submitted IN FRENCH.
ageLimit: None stated in the edital text read.
subjectScope: Master's and doctoral programmes across the participating Brazilian universities, per the 'Tabela de Mestrados e Doutorados das IES brasileiras' published with each call. The 2026 edition offered 889 places (539 master's, 350 doctoral) across 62 Brazilian universities. Whether any of them is a music-technology / electronic-music master's is UNVERIFIED — the programme table must be checked when the call opens.
coverage: 'a. Isenção do pagamento de matrículas, mensalidades ou anuidades acadêmicas referentes ao programa de estudos para o qual foi selecionado(a). b. Bolsa de estudo: Mestrado: Bolsas mensais, tendo como referência mínima o valor pago pelas agências [de fomento brasileiras]' — i.e. full tuition waiver plus a monthly stipend benchmarked to the standard Brazilian funding-agency master's rate. AIRFARE AND VISA COSTS ARE NOT COVERED (requirement 3.1.e explicitly requires the candidate to be able to fund them).
deadline: 5th edition (GCUB-Mob Nº 001/2026): applications closed 6 July 2026, for studies beginning in 2027. 4th edition timetable read from the edital PDF: applications 26/03/2025 – 09/05/2025, results published 03/10/2025. A 6th edition for a 2028 start would be expected around March–July 2027. NOTE: this means the 2026 call — the one aligned to a 2027 start — HAS ALREADY CLOSED (6 July 2026).
applicationOpens: Varies: late March in the 4th edition, spring in the 5th edition.
howToApply: Free online application through the GCUB portal (https://www.gcub.org.br/bsp/). Results published at https://www.gcub.org.br/.
requiresAdmissionFirst: No — candidates choose from the published table of Brazilian master's/doctoral programmes within the call itself; selection is run by GCUB with the host universities.
notes: The eligibility text above was extracted from the official 4th-edition edital PDF (Edital GCUB-Mob Nº 001/2025) mirrored at https://ppgcta.ufc.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/edital-gcub-4a-ediCAo.pdf, since gcub.org.br returns 403 to automated fetching. Selection explicitly weights geographic distribution and gives preference to candidates from countries with LOWER Human Development Index ('Considerando os demais critérios, terão preferência os(as) candidatos(as) dos países com menor IDH') — Tunisia has a relatively high HDI for Africa, which is a mild disadvantage. Scholars must return to their country of origin within 30 days of finishing. THIS IS THE BEST BRAZILIAN ROUTE AFTER PEC-PG and the one that does NOT require securing admission first.
verificationStatus: Eligibility clause: DIRECTLY VERIFIED from the official edital PDF (4th edition). 2027-cycle dates UNVERIFIED.

scholarshipName: Global Korea Scholarship — Graduate Degree (GKS-G), Embassy Track
provider: NIIED (National Institute for International Education), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE — YES, WITH AN EMBASSY QUOTA. The 6-place figure reported by the other agent is CORROBORATED but only from a secondary aggregator: KoreaAdmit's per-country quota table gives Tunisia GKS-U (undergraduate) = 0 places and GKS-G (graduate) = 6 places under the General strand for 2026, stating 'Every figure is transcribed from the official NIIED application guidelines' and citing the '2026 GKS-G Application Guidelines' (NIIED, February 2025) and '2026 GKS-U Application Guidelines' (NIIED, October 2025). I COULD NOT OPEN THE NIIED PDF OR THE KOREAN EMBASSY IN TUNIS PAGE DIRECTLY — the 6-place figure is therefore CORROBORATED BUT NOT PRIMARY-VERIFIED. Overall 2026 GKS-G intake: 2,000 graduate students, 800 via the Embassy Track and 1,200 via the University Track.
ageLimit: Under 40 as of 1 September of the entry year (standard GKS rule) — UNVERIFIED against the 2026/2027 guideline. Also requires having graduated (or being due to graduate) with a bachelor's degree, and a GPA requirement of 80/100 or 2.64/4.0 or top 20% of class.
subjectScope: All fields; the candidate selects up to three universities from the designated GKS university list. Korean universities with electronic music / music technology master's include Korea National University of Arts (K-Arts) and Sungkyunkwan/Kyung Hee-type media-arts departments — whether these appear on the 2027 GKS designated-university list for the Embassy Track is UNVERIFIED.
coverage: Full tuition, airfare, monthly allowance (approx. KRW 1,000,000/month for graduate students), settlement allowance, one year of Korean language training at a designated institute, medical insurance, and a thesis-printing allowance. Exact 2027 amounts UNVERIFIED.
deadline: GKS-G Embassy Track applications are normally submitted to the Korean Embassy in the applicant's country in FEBRUARY–MARCH, with results announced in stages (embassy screening → NIIED screening → university screening) through May–June, Korean language year starting September, and degree study starting the FOLLOWING March. TIMELINE IMPLICATION FOR A SEPTEMBER 2027 START: the applicant would apply to the Korean Embassy in Tunis around FEBRUARY–MARCH 2027, arrive in Korea SEPTEMBER 2027 for the compulsory one-year Korean language programme, and begin the master's degree in MARCH 2028. Exact 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
applicationOpens: Typically the guideline is published by NIIED in late January/February and the embassy window opens immediately after.
howToApply: EMBASSY TRACK: apply to the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Tunis with the full NIIED application pack; the embassy screens and nominates against Tunisia's quota. UNIVERSITY TRACK: apply directly to one designated Korean university (only one may be chosen), which nominates to NIIED — this track has 1,200 places globally and is NOT constrained by Tunisia's 6-place embassy quota, so it is worth pursuing in parallel. Official portal: https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr .
requiresAdmissionFirst: No — GKS selection precedes and determines university placement; the applicant lists university/department preferences within the GKS application.
notes: The 6 GKS-G places for Tunisia is a plausible and specific figure and matches the shape of NIIED's North-Africa allocations, but it comes from an aggregator. BEFORE RELYING ON IT, the applicant should download the '2027 GKS-G Application Guidelines' from https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr (Notice board) when published, and check Appendix 'Available Countries and Quota', and cross-check with the Korean Embassy in Tunis. Note the compulsory Korean-language year makes the effective commitment 3 years for a 2-year master's, and note that a 'September 2027' target only reaches the language course, not the degree.
verificationStatus: Tunisia has a GKS-G embassy quota: high confidence. The specific figure of 6: CORROBORATED BY ONE AGGREGATOR CITING NIIED, NOT PRIMARY-VERIFIED. NIIED PDF and Korean-embassy-in-Tunis page: UNVERIFIED (not reachable).
